notes: OCI Budgets only send email alerts — they do not delete resources.
Hard enforcement is deploy/oci_cost_guard.py via GitHub Actions (daily cron + workflow_dispatch).
Before terraform apply, --check-only refuses create when MTD Usage API cost >= costLimitUsd (exit 10).
When MTD Usage API cost for the compartment >= costLimitUsd, the script runs terraform destroy on the robot stack (Container Instance + VCN + budget).
Usage API cost data can lag up to ~24h — treat the kill as eventual, not instantaneous.
